# Stages

Source: [`Kernel/Stages.wl`](../../Kernel/Stages.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#stages-kernelstageswl--savestage-loadstage)

SaveStage / LoadStage: any stage to a .wdx file and back, with its fingerprint checked on load and, optionally, the stages it must have been built from (theory, ansatz, regulator, symmetries, ...). Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Stages".

## Symbols

### `SaveStage`

`SaveStage[stage, file]` writes a stage (with every stage it embeds) to file (.wdx) and returns the file name.

### `LoadStage`

`LoadStage[file, "Expect" -> {stage1, ...}]` reads a stage saved by SaveStage, checks its fingerprint and that it was built from every stage listed in "Expect" (e.g. the current theory, ansatz, regulator and symmetries); a mismatch aborts.

### `StageFingerprints`

`StageFingerprints[stage]` lists the fingerprints of the stage, of every stage it embeds and of their upstream stages.
